research_objective: Continue safety-weighted GRPO from the V10 checkpoint-10 training candidate, improve the original SFT on retry/safe-end residuals without added wrong side-effecting actions, then exceed Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on a fresh entity-disjoint sealed benchmark.

v11_continuation_initializer.selection_role: V10 development feedback only; V11 selection and sealed entities are new

units_and_metrics.primary_metric: mean entity-level complete-trajectory pass rate over both detectors and all primary scenarios

sealed_test_objective.strong_superiority_if: entity-clustered paired bootstrap 95% confidence interval lower bound for target_grpo minus larger_reference is greater than zero
sealed_test_objective.if_point_estimate_wins_but_interval_cros: Report point-estimate superiority only; do not claim stable superiority.
sealed_test_objective.if_objective_fails: Do not rerun or rescore the V11 sealed test; open a new study version with a new sealed test.

anti_leakage_rules: V11 train, support, selection, and sealed splits use new protected values and entity IDs disjoint from V6-V10.
V10 selection outcomes may choose the V11 recipe and continuation initializer but cannot enter V11 train, support, selection, or sealed rows.
V11 checkpoint selection cannot use the larger reference.
Support, safety, promotion, and sealed objective thresholds cannot be relaxed after V11 sampling begins.
